title: xmltocsv action
description: Converts an XML body to CSV: each child of the root is a record, each of its children a field.

includeHeader.title: Include header
includeHeader.description: Start with a line of column names

includeIndexColumn.title: Include index column
includeIndexColumn.description: Start every record with its number (1, 2, ...)

lineSeparator.title: Line separator
lineSeparator.description: The end of every line: linefeed (\n), carriage_return (\r), carriage_return_linefeed (\r\n) or endofline (that of the system)

orderHeaders.title: Order headers
orderHeaders.description: Columns in the order they first appear (unordered) or alphabetically from A (ascending, or ordered) or from Z (descending)

quoteFields.title: Quote fields
quoteFields.description: Which fields to quote: all, the non-empty ones, all but whole numbers, or none; a field holding the delimiter, a quote or a line break is always quoted

xPathExpression.title: XPath expression
xPathExpression.description: The elements it selects are the records, such as /items/item; by default the children of the root
